offering_description.value: Develops and commercializes small-molecule drugs for hematology and oncology. Sells approved medicines to specialty pharmacies and distributors serving physicians and patients, and advances a pipeline of clinical-stage candidates. Relies on contract manufacturers and partners for production and some development.

primary_products.value: immune thrombocytopenia treatment (fostamatinib); relapsed/refractory IDH1-mutated AML treatment (olutasidenib); clinical-stage oncology and hematology candidates

customer_segment.value: B2B: specialty pharmacies, wholesalers and distributors serving hematologists, oncologists and hospitals; B2C: patients with ITP and AML who receive prescribed treatments

revenue_model.value: product sales: net sales of prescription drugs for ITP and AML; licensing or royalties: collaboration, license and royalty revenue from pharma partners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops and markets branded drugs made by contract manufacturers, sold to specialty pharmacies and distributors

geography_served.value: global: Commercial sales mainly in the US, partners commercialize in Europe, Japan, Canada and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: small-molecule hematology and oncology drugs plus clinical pipeline

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: specialty pharmacies and wholesalers dispensing prescription drugs; partners / resellers: licensed partners commercializing outside the US

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug development and sales need FDA and EMA approval, clinical trial, manufacturing and reimbursement rules apply

notes: Product list is from memory; pipeline and partnered assets may have changed.
